projects.intro: A curatorial collection of front-end applications, desktop automation systems, community databases, and sustainable cultural merchandise.

items.text: A responsive web platform designed to help university students and campus organizations track, discover, and RSVP to upcoming academic and extracurricular events in real time. Features localized caching and lightweight instant search.
items.title: Campus Event Hub Calendar
items.imageAlt: Campus Event Hub calendar app shown on a laptop

items.text: A robust Java desktop application built to automate salary computations, calculate precise overtime pay, manage standard tax and insurance deductions, and generate formatted pay slips with strict numerical fidelity.
items.title: Payroll Calculator
items.imageAlt: Payroll calculator desktop app on a laptop

items.title: GELACE Bike Rental System
items.text: A Java console system for a bike rental shop that lists five bike types with hourly rates, collects a renter application form, then prints a receipt with the total cost, Manila-time rental start and end, and the customer's change.

items.title: Inventory Management System
items.text: A menu-driven Java inventory system for managing products and suppliers, receiving and issuing stock with supplier validation, and viewing live stock-level reports — structured with object-oriented classes and polymorphic stock transactions.

An organized, high-efficiency data management solution utilizing Microsoft Excel for logging community resident profiles, issuing certificates, and streamlining local barangay administration workflow.
items.title: Barangay Information System

items.text: An award-winning creative design initiative blending traditional Bulacan heritage and cultural patterns into contemporary, functional sustainable bag merchandise. Built upon extensive community research on indigenous Singkaban artistry.
items.title: DTI Bulacan Cultural Bag Design
items.imageAlt: Bulacan cultural tote bag with Singkaban and Barasoain Church Design

projects.title: Featured Engineering & Design

barangay.text: Streamlined local government operations across Paombong, Bulacan by structuring resident records and streamlining clearances.
barangay.title: Barangay Information System
highlights: Automated validation checks preventing redundant citizen records
VLOOKUP & INDEX/MATCH data querying producing printable certificates within seconds
Protected spreadsheet schemas ensuring data integrity across multiple administrative staff

showcase.text: Full portfolio deck covering brand narrative, typography pairing, pattern exploration, and consumer prototype reviews.
showcase.title: Bulacan Heritage Bag — Design Showcase
highlights: Multiple iterations crafted via Canva and vector concept art tools
Detailed color harmonies derived from native flora and folk arts
Comprehensive mockups across tote, messenger, and pouch variations

campus-hub.text: Built specifically for university clubs at Bulacan State University to coordinate schedules without overlapping venues.
campus-hub.title: Campus Event Hub Calendar
highlights: State persistence handled through clean LocalStorage abstraction layers
Responsive layout adapts cleanly from single-column mobile viewports to calendar grids
Search query parser with instant debounced results

case-study.text: A complete workflow audit illustrating how manual paper filing was replaced by structured record management, cutting issuance processing time by 70%.
case-study.title: Barangay Information System — Case Study
highlights: Stakeholder interviews conducted with local barangay executives
Zero-software-overhead deployment targeting existing spreadsheet installations
Structured schema documentation and staff onboarding guide

exhibition.text: A fusion of historical Bulakenyo crafts with modern everyday fashion, featuring iconic bamboo carving and festive Singkaban silhouettes.
exhibition.title: Bulacan Cultural Bag Design
highlights: Recognized as a leading entry in regional cultural design showcases
Sustainable canvas and jute material specifications
Aryclic Paint and Canvas honoring traditional festival aesthetics and national heritage

payroll-docs.text: Comprehensive employee payroll engine managing regular hours, Philippine statutory contributions (SSS, PhilHealth, Pag-IBIG), and overtime multipliers.
payroll-docs.title: Payroll Calculator & Tax Deductor
highlights: Strict Object-Oriented Design isolating computation algorithms from UI rendering
Robust exception-handling for invalid employee data entry
Modular printable slip formatter with clean tabular alignment
Swing/AWT components styled for clarity and ergonomic data entry

bike-rental.title: GELACE Bike Rental System
bike-rental.text: A complete rental flow in the terminal — from choosing a bike to printing the receipt — built as an object-oriented Java program.
highlights: Bike catalog stored in parallel arrays (Road, Mountain, Fixie, Fat, Folding) with per-hour pricing in PHP
Menu loop with input validation and an exit option, using a switch on the selected bike
Separate RentalForm class captures renter name, address, gender and age for the receipt
Computes total cost by rental hours, then shows start and end times in Asia/Manila time via java.time
Accepts payment and calculates the customer's change

inventory.title: Inventory Management System
inventory.text: A modular inventory tool with separate managers for products, suppliers and stock movement, designed around core OOP principles.
highlights: Product CRUD: add, view, search by ID, update and delete items
Supplier records (ID, name, contact) used to validate every stock delivery
Abstract Transaction class with ReceiveStock and IssueStock subclasses — polymorphic stock processing
Dedicated InventoryManager, SupplierManager and StockManager classes for clean separation of concerns
Stock-level and product reports from the main menu
